key_insight: Pretraining-stage alignment should do more than remove unsafe data: inserting regular safety reflections during pretraining helps models learn self-monitoring and reduces unsafe behavior later.
engineering_relevance: For LLM training pipelines, this suggests a lightweight pretraining intervention that can complement post-training to improve safety robustness against both inference-time and finetuning attacks.
method: Insert short safety reflections periodically into pretraining corpora.
Train models to integrate self-monitoring directly into language modeling.
Reinforce the learned safety behavior with compatible post-training.
evidence_signal: In experiments with 1.7B models pretrained on FineWeb-Edu, the method improved safety classification accuracy and substantially lowered attack success rates, with MedSafetyWorld providing controlled evidence against unsafe generalization from safe data.
watch_item: The approach depends on how well the inserted reflections and post-training are matched to the target model and data distribution, so transferability and corpus design need careful validation.
paper_title: Beyond Safe Data: Pretraining-Stage Alignment with Regular Safety Reflection
